title: Spaghetti Carbonara
summary: A classic Italian pasta dish with eggs, cheese, bacon, and black pepper.
instructions: Boil the spaghetti until al dente.
Beat the eggs and mix with grated Parmesan.
Combine spaghetti with pancetta and egg-cheese mixture.
Season with black pepper and serve immediately.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
summary: Chunks of grilled chicken (tikka) cooked in a smooth buttery & creamy tomato based gravy.
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices for 1 hour.
Prepare gravy with onion, tomato puree, and spices.
Add grilled chicken to the gravy and simmer.
Serve hot with rice or naan.
